entries.name: Shadow and Flame

desc.1: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 4% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 4% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 20% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 20% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.
desc.2: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 8% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 8% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 40% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 40% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.
desc.3: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 12% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 12% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 60% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 60% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.
desc.4: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 16% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 16% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 80% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 80% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.
desc.5: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Shadow and Flame's damage bonuses 4/8/12/16/20%, up from 2/4/6/8/10% (client 70753 still 2 to 10); confirmed by hotfix push 113527 (2026-11-03, curves 111671 and 111672: 4/8/12/16/20)

entries.name: Wrack

desc.1: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 86 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Wrack's base damage a second grows 2.5 a level, 36 to 86 at 60, and its spell damage coefficient doubles to 0.286 a second (client 70753 still 36); confirmed by hotfix push 113527 (2026-11-03, SpellEffect 1349556 of 1316697: 36 base, 2.5 a level, coefficient 0.286)
